_comment: Criticality direction declared by CommonRoad-CriMe 0.4.5 for every implemented measure (TypeMonotone.POS: larger = more critical; NEG: smaller = more critical). Extracted from the installed toolbox so the analysis does not need it installed. Stubs (ACI, AGS, CS, PRI, P_SMH, P_SRS, PTTC, RSS, SP, TC, TV) return None in 0.4.5 and were excluded; TTM is the generic base of TTB/TTK/TTS/TTR.
